title: Japanese Pork Belly Bento
description: A delicious and savory Japanese-inspired dish featuring pork belly, served in a traditional bento box.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, and sugar.
Place the pork belly in a shallow dish and brush the miso mixture evenly over both sides.
Let the pork sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Place the pork belly in a baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce heat to 325°F (160°C) and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
While the pork is cooking, prepare the Japanese rice according to package instructions.
Once the pork is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
To assemble the bento, place a scoop of Japanese rice in the bottom of a bento box, followed by sliced pork, green onions, and sesame seeds.
